race.comment: The Hannans Handicap is now at Listed level and COOL MEMORY (3) gets the nod. He jumped favourite in this race 12 months ago and was only 1.6L off the winner. He was solid first-up and his trial since was good and everything looks to set up beautifully for him. Can find the front and will take catching. ELITE MISSILE (10) boasts a good fresh record and looks primed for a strong showing on the back of two trials coming into this. Will need a touch of luck from the barrier draw, though there looks to be good speed engaged and he'll be making his presence felt late in the race. CORRECT CHOICE (6) comes back to 1400m now after a strong win over the mile at Belmont last time out. Blinkers go back on now and he boasts a solid third-up record. Watch for him late in the race. DONT WAIT FOR LUCK (9) is better than he showed last time out when missing as favourite. Fiore rides now and he can feature on his best form. SILVER EYE (13) is racing well without winning and can't be left out.
